description: List the crypto assets and chains a buyer can pay with on Port66 (for example BTC on Bitcoin, SOL on Solana, ETH or USDC on Ethereum, Arbitrum or Base). Payments go through NEAR Intents and the seller always receives the exact price in USDC. Returns `available` (whether cross-chain payment is switched on) and `assets`, each with a symbol and chain to use as pay_with and chain in price_in_crypto. Takes no input.
name: payment_options
title: Payment options
